facts.fact: The World Bank's results framework for project P175840 counts 69 public health facilities reporting data in DHIS2 at 31 August 2024, from a baseline of 0 in May 2021 and against a target of 80 by December 2025; it gives no denominator and does not split primary clinics from hospitals.

The World Bank reports the successful deployment of DHIS2 as the new health information system as a key achievement of the project, with more than 60 facilities reporting data through it so that programmes can monitor key indicators; the indicator stood at 69 on both 23 May 2024 and 31 August 2024.

DHIS2 was deployed under component 2 (health system strengthening, cost USD 24.7 million) of the World Bank IDA-financed project P175840, whose implementing agency is the Ministry of Health; the report names no domestic funding for the system.
